# SEO authority scope

Indexable growth work must prioritize CHUDO-owned, useful pages and verified canonical records.

Do not reverse the following protections merely to increase URL count:

- source-only news detail pages: `noindex,follow`;
- Telegram/media source archives and derivative pagination: `noindex,follow`;
- empty canonical database catalogs: `noindex,follow`;
- political-prisoner auto-designation: forbidden;
- third-party visitor-runtime requests: zero.

Search growth is measured by useful indexed pages, impressions, qualified clicks, citations and corrections—not by raw generated URL count.
